classification: configured geometry and theoretical calculations, not physical accuracy or measured valid point counts

vacuum_experiment_committed_config.classification: uncalibrated engineering equivalent, not a validated pneumatic digital twin
vacuum_experiment_committed_config.pressure_convention: positive gauge vacuum: ambient absolute pressure minus chamber absolute pressure, Pa
vacuum_experiment_committed_config.seal_geometry_note: Per-cup coverage interpolated over box top edge distance 20 to 34 mm; axial tolerance accounts for preexisting tool collision geometry. Cups remain visual geometry, tool collision supplies contact evidence.
vacuum_experiment_committed_config.load_measurement: box mass * (filtered measured acceleration - gravity); lateral load and CoG moment resolved into tool frame; no joint-wrench reaction measurement

fault_tests.leak: extra 0.5 L/s per cup after 2 s attached
fault_tests.overload: inject 1000 N extra normal demand after 2 s attached; software trip test, not physical added payload

limitations: Fixed attachment constraint still used while capacity checks pass
No flexible cup deformation, hose CFD, pump curve calibration or carton porosity validation
Pressure dynamics are lumped linear conductance approximations
Load estimates include gravity even when the box is supported by a surface
All pneumatic constants and protection thresholds require hardware calibration
Existing parameter_report.json was copied from baseline and is historical; this file describes new vacuum behavior
